metadata.purpose: Share one producer and synchronously replay recent values to later subscribers, retaining successful completion.

conditions: SharedReplay is project notation for shared connection plus buffered late delivery, not a Cω primitive.
Live subscribers receive current values; late subscribers also receive up to bufferSize eligible previous values.
Each subscriber has its own output T*; replay fan-out changes total notification multiplicity, not source cardinality.

scope.parameters: ReplaySubject(bufferSize=2,windowTime=6), refCount=false; nonnegative safe-integer sizes and windows; zero clamped to one
scope.callbacks: No user callback, custom connector, observer side effects, or reset-notifier function is executed in the pure model.
scope.time: Source-clock values are supplied by event.now. Expiry happens when ReplaySubject trims on next/subscribe; expireAt <= now is excluded. No timer runs to evict values.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic, non-reentrant subscriber registration and source delivery after connection setup. Synchronous replay occurs before a retained terminal signal.
exclusions: Arbitrary reentrant subscriptions/teardown and throwing observers or finalizers.
Custom timestamp providers not modeled as explicitly supplied event time, fractional/negative/infinite-boundary arithmetic, and arbitrary ObservableInput conversion.
No production effect interpreter or claim that finite tests establish full equivalence.

initialization.sourceSubscription: First subscriber registers to a fresh ReplaySubject and connects upstream; no initial value exists.

ownership.sharing: One replay buffer and source connection per resulting shared Observable, not per subscriber.
ownership.reset: Error always resets; successful completion never resets; last live departure resets only with refCount=true.

dispatch.actionSemantics: After state update, append replay notifications before the baseline terminal action; preserve addressed live delivery and release ordering.
cancellationCheckpoints: One departure removes only that subscriber. Last departure disconnects only when refCount=true and source has not completed.
Reset clears replay memory; completion retains memory but later subscriptions still trim by the supplied source clock.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID and available connection generation; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: replay the nonexpired cached values in FIFO order before the terminal notification (if any)
subscribe to the source under a fresh connection generation
rules.nextState: one registered subscriber and one connection; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: A joining subscriber receives the current replay buffer, oldest first, synchronously. A completed shared source replays its retained buffer and then completes without reconnecting. Constructing the shared Observable starts nothing. Its first subscriber creates a Subject-backed connection to the source; that connection is shared by overlapping subscribers.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: replay the nonexpired cached values in FIFO order before the terminal notification (if any)
rules.nextState: append subscriber to the existing connection, without replay; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: A joining subscriber receives the current replay buffer, oldest first, synchronously. A completed shared source replays its retained buffer and then completes without reconnecting. A subscriber joining a live connection receives future values, not past values. It does not create another source subscription. Sharing is not replay.

rules.guard: current source generation; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: append incoming value to time/count-bounded replay memory
forward the value to each currently registered subscriber in registration order
rules.nextState: retain the connection and registry; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: Store the unchanged value and its source-clock expiry (if finite); trim by count and time, then broadcast to currently subscribed observers. A retained connection continues buffering with zero observers.

rules.guard: registered subscriber and at least one other remains; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: discard replay memory if connection resets
rules.nextState: remove only this subscriber; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: Unsubscribe this subscriber without sending completion. Last departure disconnects and clears replay memory only with refCount=true; otherwise keep connection and replay memory.

rules.guard: the last registered subscriber leaves; resetOnRefCountZero=false; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: discard replay memory if connection resets
rules.nextState: keep the source connected with an empty subscriber registry; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: Unsubscribe this subscriber without sending completion. Last departure disconnects and clears replay memory only with refCount=true; otherwise keep connection and replay memory.

rules.guard: current generation; resetOnComplete=false; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: send complete to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: retain terminal status with no live connection or registered subscribers; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: Completion terminates present subscribers and releases the source, but retains the ReplaySubject buffer for late subscribers; time-window expiry continues to apply.

rules.guard: fresh subscription ID; retained terminal Subject; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: replay the nonexpired cached values in FIFO order before the terminal notification (if any)
send the cached complete to this subscriber only
rules.nextState: remain terminated without connecting or retaining the new subscriber; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: A joining subscriber receives the current replay buffer, oldest first, synchronously. A completed shared source replays its retained buffer and then completes without reconnecting. A subscriber arriving after retained complete immediately receives that complete, with no replayed value and no new source connection.

rules.guard: current generation; resetOnError=true; environment clock must not move backwards
actions: discard replay memory if connection resets
send error to each current subscriber
rules.nextState: reset for a later fresh subscription; replay memory retained, pruned or reset according to the event
rules.explanation: A source error ends present subscribers, tears down the connection and resets the replay buffer, so a later subscriber starts a new execution.
